hero.subtitle: See how DeepMind transforms communication and talent data into actionable performance, retention, and hiring intelligence without compromising privacy.

integration.title: Seamless Integration
integration.subtitle: Connect your workspace
integration.description: DeepMind connects directly to your communication platforms (Slack, Teams, Email) via read-only APIs. No manual data entry required.

privacy.title: Privacy Sanitization
privacy.subtitle: GDPR-compliant anonymization
privacy.description: Before any data touches our AI, personally identifiable information (PII) is stripped and encrypted locally. We analyze patterns, not private conversations.

analysis.title: Cognitive Analysis
analysis.subtitle: The AI engine at work
analysis.description: Our proprietary NLP models analyze metadata, sentiment, and communication frequency to detect patterns linked to performance drag, turnover risk, and hiring gaps.

intelligence.title: Actionable Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: Insights that matter
intelligence.description: Raw data is transformed into actionable scores for managers and HR leaders. Receive alerts and recommendations before performance drops or key talent exits.

zeroRetention.title: Zero-Retention Policy
zeroRetention.description: We do not store message bodies. Once analysis is complete (milliseconds), the raw text is discarded. Only the metadata scores are kept.

siloedData.title: Siloed Data Architecture
siloedData.description: Every organization's data is logically isolated. Your team's patterns will never be used to train models for other companies.

blindSpots.title: Manager Blind-Spots
blindSpots.description: Managers see aggregated team data (min. 5 members). Individual data is private to the employee unless explicitly shared.
